== Summary ==
A new local player, named in the report only as Kate, after a Sunday local tournament in the Twin Cities, Minnesota, organized by [[Mark Walseth]] in November 2014. The report: "New Local Player KATE Takes the 3 Way Tie for FIRST PLACE!" (26 players). The event has no wiki page; the photograph sits on [[List of SWCCG tournaments]] (2014).

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=921575#p921575 post 921575] in topic 56554 (Twin Cities, MN), by Walsetmd, 2014-11-24. Forum attachment id 4096.jpg (Kate O.jpg). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122220957/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p921575.html Internet Archive]
